⏰ Cron commands:
/cron add <schedule> <task> — Add a scheduled task
/cron list — List all schedules
/cron delete <id> — Delete a schedule
/cron pause <id> — Pause a schedule
/cron resume <id> — Resume a schedule
/cron run <id> — Run immediately

Examples:
/cron add daily 9am go test ./...
/cron add every monday morning Generate git activity summary
